messages:
incident-bot: Paging @here: Severity P1 - multiple containers in gpu-pool-18 are crashlooping (OOM/segfault) since 09:31 UTC. Affected service: runtime-engine (vLLM-based runtime). Logs show repeated SIGSEGV in fused_attention.so. pod examples: runtime-5f9c8 (node gpu-18a), runtime-6b2d1 (node gpu-18b). Generating thread for live mitigation.
Alice (oncall): I'm taking this. first pass: are we seeing widespread customer 5xxs? @Eva any CS signal?
Eva (support): Observed ~1.8% 5xx increase on hosted API for the last 6m, mostly short gen jobs from beta customers. No major escalations yet but two customers reported failures. ETA to customers: "investigating".
Carla (eng-sre): Node-level note: node gpu-18b is flapping (kubelet restarting due to container crashloops) and OOMKill in dmesg referencing gpu driver memory allocations. nvml logs show GPU mem spike then process SIGSEGV.
Ben (eng-runtime): Copy. From pod logs (tail):
```
[2026-03-12T09:28:47Z] serving: allocating KV cache 1.2GB
[2026-03-12T09:28:47Z] fused_attention.so: segfault (pc=0x7f9a8c1f)
Backtrace:
  runtime_engine::fused_attention+0xbc
  runtime_engine::forward+0x1a7
  vllm::Model::generate
```
Ben (eng-runtime): Looks like a fused kernel / quant path regression (recent change in kernel selector landed in canary). Could be a bad kernel compiled without proper checks.
Alice (oncall): Immediate mitigation options?
Devon (platform): We can roll traffic off gpu-pool-18 and scale up gpu-pool-10 (same region) with spare capacity. Also can force-routing to previous runtime image (runtime:v2026-03-09-stable) which doesn't contain the new fused kernel. I can patch routing.
Ben (eng-runtime): +1 to revert to stable image. Also we should disable fused attention selection via env var `RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1` as a hot mitigation if image revert is slow.
Carla (eng-sre): I'll cordon node gpu-18b to stop scheduling and evict existing pods after we snapshot coredumps. Steps I'll run: `kubectl cordon gpu-18b && kubectl delete pod runtime-6b2d1 --grace-period=0 --force` once debug bundle captured.
Alice (oncall): Collecting debug bundle now. @ops-bot please run `coredumpctl` on gpu-18b and upload to /incidents/1748559876/debug/
ops-bot: Running: `ssh gpu-18b sudo coredumpctl -o /tmp/runtime-6b2d1.core --no-pid --output-profile` -> uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/1748559876/runtime-6b2d1.core
Ben (eng-runtime): I'll pull the core. Running quick gdb: `gdb /opt/runtime/bin/runtime /tmp/runtime-6b2d1.core -ex "bt full" -ex quit` shows crash in fused_attention.cu at `compute_qk_block` around `shared_mem` access. Suspect out-of-bounds index on a warp.
Ben (eng-runtime): Repro locally with small harness, reproduces on RTX A5000 when sequence length > 4096 and quantized path enabled.
Carla (eng-sre): Customer impact: rerouting in progress. @Devon update?
Devon (platform): Traffic shift started at 09:39 UTC. Routing rule: move 95% of new sessions away from gpu-pool-18 to gpu-pool-10 and gpu-pool-11. Console: applied policy `fallback_on_pool_failure: true`. It will take ~90s to drain.
Alice (oncall): While routing moves, let's apply env var on the Deployment for runtime to disable fused attention. Ben, can you provide the exact k8s patch?
Ben (eng-runtime): Patch:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/runtime RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/runtime
```
Ben (eng-runtime): Doing that now on the canary subset first (10% traffic) to validate.
Carla (eng-sre): Monitoring metrics: GPU mem usage on gpu-18a peaked then dropped after restart of runtime on that node. Crashloop frequency decreased from 1/min to 0.05/min after canary patch.
Alice (oncall): Good. Are there any kernel/driver mismatches? Node shows `nvidia-driver 525.85` installed.
Ben (eng-runtime): No driver mismatch. This is discrete to our fused kernel. There's a recent build of fused_attention.so from commit `a9f3c2` included in `runtime:v2026-03-12-canary`.
Devon (platform): We've rolled the stable image `runtime:v2026-03-09-stable` into gpu-pool-18 as an emergency fallback for remaining pods that didn't restart. This should fully stop new crashloops.
Alice (oncall): Carla, start cordon + drain for gpu-18b now that debug bundle is uploaded.
Carla (eng-sre): Cordon done. Evicting pods. Noting one pod failed to evict due to CrashLoopBackOff; I'll force delete after final snapshot. Force deleted runtime-6b2d1 and it rescheduled onto gpu-pool-10.
Eva (support): Customer update prepared: "We identified a runtime engine regression causing intermittent crashes for some GPU-backed workloads. We have rolled back the runtime on impacted hosts and are routing traffic to healthy pools. Engineers are investigating root cause. We will follow up with postmortem and timeline." Approving to send.
Alice (oncall): Ben can you confirm whether a hotfix is preferred (rebuild fused kernel with bounds checks) or full revert?
Ben (eng-runtime): For immediate safety: full revert to stable fused kernel (or disable fused path). For long-term: we need a patched fused kernel with extra index checks + unit tests simulating long sequences and quantized path. I'll open a PR `runtime/fused-fix` and link the coredump + minimal repro harness.
Ben (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/487 (draft) includes NVTX markers and extra bounds checks.
Carla (eng-sre): Current status: crashloops stopped, routing 100% away from gpu-pool-18 in 2m. No further 5xxs after 09:48 UTC. Node gpu-18b remains cordoned and will be reprovisioned after deeper inspection.
Alice (oncall): Handoff: I'll stay on till 10:15 UTC to ensure stability, then hand to daytime oncall @Ben for deeper root cause. Next steps for postmortem: collect timeline, attach core, gdb output, kernel oops if any, and customer impact timeline. Assign owners: Ben -> root cause + fix, Carla -> infra remediation and node health, Devon -> routing + rollback docs, Eva -> customer comms.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created INC-2026-3492, pinned to this thread.
Alice (oncall): Thanks team. If anything new appears ping here. :thumbsup:
Ben (eng-runtime): I'll continue work on the PR and run extended CI on A5000/RTX families.
Carla (eng-sre): Will uncordon gpu-18b only after validated rebuild and kernel checks. Logging the coredump artifacts location and kube events under the ticket.
Eva (support): Sent customer notification at 09:58 UTC. Will follow up with another update after postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident closed to P1 paging at 10:05 UTC — mitigation applied (traffic rerouted + runtime rollback). Please file postmortem within 72h.
Alice (oncall): Closing thread, moving to postmortem doc."
